latest_release.body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 2.4.0 -->

## What's Changed
### New Checks and Features
* Adds expanded check view and copy buttons to results by @lissy93 in https://github.com/lissy93/web-check/pull/372
### Fixes and Improvements
* Improved UI for result card by @lissy93 in https://github.com/lissy93/web-check/pull/355
* Adds default DKIM selectors for cyber_Folks, MyDevil, Hostinger and Brevo by @Eales in https://github.com/lissy93/web-check/pull/358
* Adds light mode and accessibility settings by @lissy93 in https://github.com/lissy93/web-check/pull/363
* Add the NetAPI compromised feed to the threats check (no API key needed) by @slavaolesik in https://github.com/lissy93/web-check/pull/371
* Results page no cache stale results, and bump patch for dep updates by @lissy93 in https://github.com/lissy93/web-check/pull/378
### Docs, Deployment and CI
* Shows a reload message when the firewall's browser verification expire by @lissy93 in https://github.com/lissy93/web-check/pull/359
* Stops Trivy from blocking the weekly Docker rebuild by @lissy93 in https://github.com/lissy93/web-check/pull/366
### Dependencies
* Astro tooling upgrade by @lissy93 in https://github.com/lissy93/web-check/pull/354
* Bump undici from 7.30.0 to 7.30.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/lissy93/web-check/pull/370
* Bump body-parser from 2.3.0 to 2.4.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/lissy93/web-check/pull/369
* Bump fast-uri from 3.1.8 to 3.1.9 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/lissy93/web-check/pull/368
* Bump ip-address from 10.7.3 to 10.7.5 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/lissy93/web-check/pull/367
* Bump node-forge from 1.4.0 to 1.4.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/lissy93/web-check/pull/373
* Updates dependencies, and bumps min Node to 22.23.4 by @lissy93 in https://github.com/lissy93/web-check/pull/377
### Other Changes
* Adds CAA Records and mixed content checks, and improves accuracy for other HTTPs by @lissy93 in https://github.com/lissy93/web-check/pull/349
* Add request timeouts to status and screenshot checks by @lissy93 in https://github.com/lissy93/web-check/pull/350
* Dependency update config and repo cores by @lissy93 in https://github.com/lissy93/web-check/pull/351

## New Contributors
* @Eales made their first contribution in https://github.com/lissy93/web-check/pull/358
* @dependabot[bot] made their first contribution in https://github.com/lissy93/web-check/pull/370
* @slavaolesik made their first contribution in https://github.com/lissy93/web-check/pull/371

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/lissy93/web-check/compare/2.3.0...2.4.0
